name: OTV (Oblastnoye Televideniye)
verdict: Regional television of Chelyabinsk Oblast: Rosstat classifies AO 'Obl-TV' as property of a federal subject of the Russian Federation (OKFS 13); created in 2018 by transformation of the Chelyabinsk Oblast state enterprise. On hold for a person: the database holds a record claim against the Russian Federation and chains other sub-national owners (Chinese municipalities, Uzbekistan's Fergana) to the national state — whether a Russian region's government chains the same way, and so whether the federal record reaches OTV, is a maintainer decision.
note: Chelyabinsk regional TV channel; media partner of HC Traktor (club site footer links to 1obl.ru). No documented human-rights record found for Chelyabinsk Oblast itself; the oblast is part of the Russian Federation — methodological question flagged in the PR. Held at unrated rather than 'none' so the state-record question is decided by a maintainer.
